title: Data requests
lead: People asking what is held about them, or for it to be corrected or erased. Soonest due first. Dates are in Yerevan time.
limit: Each status shows at most 200, soonest due first.

confirm.title: Is this really {{address}}?
confirm.body: Once you say so, this request can be carried out. Confirm only once the person has replied, from this very address, to an email you sent it. The form is public, so anyone can type any address: acting on an unverified request is itself a breach.

reject.title: Reject the request from {{address}}?
reject.body: A request can’t be reopened once it is rejected.

close.title: Close the correction for {{address}}?
close.body: Do this once the record has been corrected. It can’t be reopened.

export.title: Export the data of {{address}}?
export.body: The file is saved to your device at once. Nothing keeps a copy, but if it is lost, export again: the request stays open until you confirm the requester has it.
export.saved: The file was saved to your device. Nothing else keeps it: if it is lost, export again.
export.fileFailed: That file couldn’t be saved. Please try again.
export.made: Exported on {{date}}. Once the requester has the file, confirm its delivery to close the request.

erase.title: Erase the data of {{address}}?
erase.body: Nothing can undo this. Their names, contacts, answers and messages go, and an account with that address is closed. Whether they came, their seat and paid amounts stay.

count.suppressionsHashed: Do-not-contact records kept as a hash: {{count, number}}
count.privateMediaQueuedForDeletion: Private files queued for deletion: {{count, number}}

erase.recoveryPending: The erasure was applied, but one step is still waiting, so the request stays open. Press Erase again in a while to finish it.
erase.appliedWaiting: This erasure is already applied, with one step still waiting. Press Erase to finish it.

notes.label: Notes
notes.saveFirst: Save your notes first, or clear them: this step would leave them behind.
notes.tooLongToEdit: These notes are too long to edit here, as a requester’s own can be. Add to them in your own records for now.

status.confirm: Identity confirmed: it can now be carried out.
status.export: The export is made and saved.
status.erase: The erasure ran. What it did is below.
status.deliver: Delivery is confirmed, and the request is closed.

refusal.forbidden: This page is for Aveline’s administrators, as a request reaches across every customer.
refusal.moved: This request has moved on since the page was read, perhaps by someone else. It has been read again.
refusal.rateLimited: Too many requests just now. Please wait a moment and try again.
refusal.noAnswer: We didn’t get an answer, so it may have happened. Read the page again before trying again.
refusal.erasureApplied: Someone has already applied this erasure, so it can no longer be rejected. The page has been read again.
refusal.newerExport: A newer export was made meanwhile. The page has been read again: confirm the delivery of that one once it is sent.

noAddressHelp: This came from an enquiry, so it can’t be carried out on this page yet. It needs the enquiry’s record.
limitClosed: This shows at most 200, soonest due first, so the newest may be missing.

deliver.title: Confirm {{address}} has the export?
deliver.body: Confirm only once the requester has the file from the latest export. The request then closes.

submissions.title: From the public form (not verified)
submissions.show: Show what the public form said
submissions.none: The public form sent nothing for this request.
submissions.failed: What the public form said couldn’t be read. Please try again.
